units.source_text: 这是一出八场舞剧，名叫《虞美人草图》，是中国有名的项羽和虞姬的悲剧。

en.t: This is an eight-scene dance drama called Poppy Grass Picture, the famous Chinese tragedy of Xiang Yu and Consort Yu.

units.source_text: 可是，当演完了虞姬拔剑刺胸，被项羽抱在怀里，

en.t: But after the scene in which Consort Yu draws her sword, stabs herself in the breast, and is held in Xiang Yu's arms,

units.source_text: 在静听思乡的楚歌声中死去，最后项羽也战死沙场一场之后，

en.t: dies while quietly listening to the homesick songs of Chu, and finally Xiang Yu too dies in battle,

units.source_text: 就转到日本熊谷直实和平敦盛以及玉织姬的戏了。

en.t: the performance shifts to the Japanese story of Kumagai Naozane, Taira no Atsumori, and Princess Tamaori.

units.source_text: 故事是讲熊谷打败了敦盛后，深感人世间变化无常而落发出家，

en.t: The story tells how, after Kumagai defeats Atsumori, he feels deeply the impermanence of the human world and shaves his head to become a monk,

units.source_text: 随后到古战场上凭吊敦盛时，发现坟墓周围开着虞美人花，笛声可闻。

en.t: and later, when he goes to the old battlefield to mourn Atsumori, he finds poppies blooming around the grave and hears the sound of a flute.

units.source_text: 这时便出现了敦盛的鬼魂，它要求把青叶笛收藏在黑谷寺里，

en.t: At this moment Atsumori's ghost appears and asks that the Aoba flute be kept at Kurodani Temple,

units.source_text: 玉织姬的鬼魂则要求把坟边的虞美人花供奉在佛前。

en.t: while Princess Tamaori's ghost asks that the poppies by the grave be offered before the Buddha.
